build_YOLACTHead: build a YOLACT detection head with configurable anchor generator, loss functions, and mask coefficient prediction
build_YOLACTProtonet: build a YOLACT protonet mask head that outputs mask prototypes and combines them with coefficients for instance segmentation
review_YOLACTHead_forward_single: review the YOLACTHead forward_single method that produces cls scores, bbox preds, and mask coefficients from single-scale features
review_YOLACTHead_loss_by_feat: review the YOLACTHead loss_by_feat method that calculates classification and bbox losses with optional OHEM sampling
review_YOLACTProtonet_forward: review the YOLACTProtonet forward method that generates prototypes and linearly combines them with coefficients into instance masks
